cards.text: Nehemiah, the king's cupbearer (Nehemiah 1:11), got hard news about Jerusalem (Nehemiah 1:3). Now it's the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes. Wine is set before the king, and Nehemiah takes it and hands it to him.

cards.question: Nehemiah has never looked like this in front of King Artaxerxes before. The king can tell he isn't ill. What does the king say this could only be?
When King Artaxerxes asks about his sad face, Nehemiah stays calm and cool.

cards.text: If a king stared at me like that, my mustache would be packing my bags. Nehemiah answers anyway, starting with "May the king live forever!"

cards.question: Nehemiah tells King Artaxerxes why he's sad. What does he say about the city where his fathers are buried?

answers.text: It lies in ruins and its gates are burned
Its people have all been carried away
Its temple has been torn to the ground

cards.text: The king asks, "What is your request?" Friend, that's the boss leaning back in his chair going, "Okay, talk to me."

cards.question: King Artaxerxes just asked Nehemiah what he wants. What does Nehemiah do before he answers?

answers.text: Prays to the God of heaven
Asks the queen to speak for him
Asks for a night to think

cards.question: Nehemiah asks the king to send him to Judah, to the city where his fathers are buried, so he can ___ it.
King Artaxerxes asks Nehemiah how long his journey will take.

cards.text: With the queen seated beside him, the king is pleased to send Nehemiah, and Nehemiah sets a time. That's a YES. From a KING. On the FIRST ask.

cards.question: Nehemiah isn't done asking. He wants letters for the governors west of the Euphrates River. What are those letters for?

answers.text: So they'll grant him safe passage

cards.question: Nehemiah also wants a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king's ___, so that Asaph will give him timber.

cards.text: That timber's going to work, friend: beams for the gates of the citadel to the temple, for the city wall, and for the house Nehemiah will occupy.

cards.question: King Artaxerxes grants all of Nehemiah's requests. Why does Nehemiah say it happened?

answers.text: The gracious hand of his God was on him
He had served the king for years
The king owed him a favor

cards.text: So Nehemiah goes to the governors west of the Euphrates and hands them the king's letters. This man walked in to hand the king his wine and walked OUT with travel papers and a lumber order.

cards.question: King Artaxerxes sends Nehemiah off on his trip without any soldiers.

cards.text: Then two new names show up, Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official, and they hear about all of this.

cards.question: Sanballat and Tobiah are deeply ___ that someone has come to seek the ___ of the Israelites.

cards.text: Pull up a chair, friend, because this story's just getting warmed up.
